newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Feb 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Feb 4.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- President Jiang Zemin meets Daniel Tully, chairman of Merrill Lynch & Co of the United States, says he appreciates the company's help for China's financial sector
- Domestic flights can be purchased by tourists at 30 pct discount from January 1 to March 31 and in December and a 20 pct discount in peak season from April 1 to November 30
- First Auto Works plans to produce 46,000 sedans in 1997.

- Five new oil and gas fields will be exploited at the Turpan-Hami oil fields in Xinjiang this year while oil production capacity will be brought to 300,000 tonnes and natural gas will reach 424 million cubic metres.
- Japan Import and Export Bank has provided $80 millon in loans to Fuzhou's Changle international airport through the Bank of China.
- Sinopec says China to phase out the use of leaded gasoline by year 2000
- Gross Domestic Product seen growing at 11-12 percent in 1997
- More than 50 percent production capacity of China's 18 major industrial products lie idle.
- China's demand for crude oil forecast at 158.2 million tonnes in 1997, while domestic production would be 153.5 million tonnes.

- China's commercial coal demand would be 1.266 million tonnes and domestic production of coal would be 1.37 billion tonnes and China's electric production was planned to be 1145 billion kilowatts in 1997
